Source-only correction request backed by actual event trace. A exact23a1947e diagnostic candidate passed22 tests, then same-existing Save As reproduced no Replace. RequestF470D414: observer registers parent.attachedSheet=oldSheet and oldSheet.sheetParent=parent; SwiftUI onDismiss arrives (join native=false swift=true); native.didEndSheet at monotonic2625258.368449 has parent.attachedSheet=0 BUT oldSheet.sheetParent still parent. Your guard rejects the sole event because it requires sheet.sheetParent==nil. No native.detached.accepted or replacement admission follows. Original file unchanged. This is observed callback state, not a timing hypothesis. Raw trace will be published by A shortly.

Please fix narrowly: at the captured parent didEndSheet notification, determine old-sheet detachment using captured parent attachedSheet identity (old sheet no longer attached), without requiring old sheet.sheetParent metadata to already clear. Retain initial capture parent/old-sheet verification, request/state identity guards, SwiftUI join, cancellation and observer cleanup, and final parent.attachedSheet==nil replacement admission guard. Unrelated event while old sheet is still attached must not complete; a newer sheet must never be ended/dismissed by this operation. No sleeps/polling or new async timing assumptions. Add deterministic tests for native event when parent no longer attaches old sheet but sheetParent metadata remains; preserve old-still-attached rejection. Factor a small predicate/event seam if needed but keep exact native caller covered by A GUI. Keep trace diagnostic commit separate from product repair; commit tests then repair separately, all UNRUN on B. No A AppModel/Agent edits. B hold/paused heartbeat unchanged; A alone compiles/GUI/merges.
